title: Storage Space
summary: Check your Memory Storage and delete some junk.
description:
This app is for you if ...
• You want to find and delete junk files and apps cluttering up your device
• You dont have enough free memory storage
• You want to know how your memory is distributed across the operating system, apps, music and other files

Features
• Overview. A simple overview of your storage space clearly showing how much memory is available for your apps and files.
• App Manager. How many apps are installed and how much space is occupied by apps? Convenient links for uninstalling apps and clearing the cache and storage occupied by apps.
• File Manager. How much storage is occupied by your downloads, music and stuff? A file manager and cleaner is included for deleting and moving files around. Includes cloud locations like gdrive, USB/OTG drives and more.
• Storage speed. How fast is your internal storage or SDcard? How long would it take to transfer a large file? The storage speed checker does a raw file transfer to estimate the read and write speed. For Android 11 and above.
• Widgets. Home screen widgets to quickly get an idea of space available without opening the app.

Permissions
• Storage/All files permission. Required to find and delete unnecessary files in the device which may be taking up storage space.
• Query installed apps permission. Required to get list of installed apps and then select and uninstall unnecessary apps.
• Package usage stats. Required to check storage used by installed apps.

Inapp Purchases -
• Adfree
• Premium widgets
